messages.content: Before I approve the Boston flights, compare the full ticket costs, not just the displayed fares. I will have a laptop bag and one normal carry-on, but no checked bag. I also want to know whether the later return leaves enough time for one more office visit after Wednesday breakfast.

I found two workable nonstop outbounds for Monday, May 12. The 6:35 p.m. departure from DFW arrives at BOS at 11:15 p.m.; its Main Cabin fare is $229 and includes both your personal item and carry-on. The 8:05 p.m. departure arrives at 12:42 a.m.; its basic fare is $194, but a carry-on adds $45, making it $239. The earlier flight is therefore $10 less on your actual baggage needs and gets you to the Hilton about ninety minutes sooner.
So the 6:35 is both cheaper in practice and better for getting to the hotel. What are the two Wednesday choices?

The 2:20 p.m. BOS departure arrives at DFW at 5:35 p.m. Its Main Cabin fare is $209, including your personal item and carry-on. Changes are allowed without a change fee, although any fare difference applies; cancellation before departure produces a one-year airline credit. The 5:40 p.m. nonstop arrives at 8:58 p.m. Its basic fare is $168, but the carry-on costs $55, so your total is $223. That ticket is nonchangeable and only eligible for a credit after a $99 cancellation deduction.
That makes the later flight $14 more after the bag. How much useful time does it actually buy me?

Breakfast is scheduled to end at 9:30 a.m. For the 2:20 flight, you should leave the Hilton at 10:35, targeting BOS around 11:20. That does not leave a realistic office visit after breakfast. For the 5:40 flight, you could visit the nearby partner office from roughly 10:00 a.m. to 1:30 p.m., return briefly for your bag, and leave the Hilton at 2:40 p.m. That targets airport arrival around 3:25, a little over two hours before departure.
Can the hotel hold my bag after checkout, and is that partner office still walkable?

Yes. The Hilton will hold luggage after the noon checkout at no charge. The partner office is about a twelve-minute walk from the hotel, so you could check out before the visit, leave your bag with the bell desk, and collect it on the way to the airport.
Compare the complete flight totals one more time, including the combinations we would genuinely use.

Using the 6:35 Monday outbound, the round trip is $438 with the 2:20 Wednesday return and $452 with the 5:40 return. Both totals include your personal item and carry-on, and neither includes a checked bag. The $438 pair has flexible Main Cabin terms in both directions. The $452 pair gives you about three and a half hours for the extra office visit, but the return ticket is nonchangeable and has the $99 cancellation deduction.

Once the timing, nonstop routing, and bag needs are satisfied, rank the real totals by price and take the cheapest. The extra office visit is optional, and it does not justify paying more for worse ticket terms.

Then the practical choice is the $438 pair: Monday at 6:35 p.m. and Wednesday at 2:20 p.m. It is $14 cheaper than the later-return combination, reaches Boston earlier, and preserves the better change and cancellation terms. Wednesday remains breakfast only; leave the Hilton at 10:35 a.m.
Book that pair now. Keep the Hilton plan unchanged, and give me the flight confirmation and final terms.

The flights are ticketed under confirmation B7Q4LM: Monday, May 12, DFW to BOS nonstop, departing 6:35 p.m. and arriving 11:15 p.m.; Wednesday, May 14, BOS to DFW nonstop, departing 2:20 p.m. and arriving 5:35 p.m. The total charged is $438.00. One personal item and one standard carry-on are included in both directions; no checked bag is included. Both Main Cabin tickets may be changed without a change fee, subject to fare difference, and may be canceled before departure for airline credit valid for one year. The Hilton Boston Back Bay plan remains unchanged and has not yet been reserved. Leave the hotel at 10:35 a.m. Wednesday for the airport.
